name: openclaw-crm-bridge
description: Example OpenClaw skill that exposes openclaw-crm tools via the HTTP bridge. Agents can search, create, update, and delete contacts and companies conversationally.
author: KC Optimal Computing

CRM_BRIDGE_URL.description: Base URL of the openclaw-crm HTTP bridge (e.g. http://localhost:3100)

CRM_BRIDGE_API_KEY.description: Optional API key matching BRIDGE_API_KEY on the bridge. Sent as Authorization: Bearer.

CRM_AGENT_ID.description: Optional stable agent identity for audit attribution (X-Agent-Id / body agentId).
